title: Separation of Binary Mixture via Fractional Distillation
description: Separation of an ethanol-water binary mixture utilizing a Vigreux fractionating column with vapor temperature monitoring.
apparatus: Liebig Water Condenser with Recirculating Chiller
steps: Assemble fractional distillation apparatus ensuring all ground glass joints are lightly greased.
Charge round bottom flask with 50 mL ethanol and 50 mL water, adding 3 boiling chips.
Initiate counter-current cooling water through condenser jacket.
Gradually increase heating mantle voltage until gentle reflux begins in column.
Collect distillate when vapor temperature stabilizes at 78.3°C (ethanol boiling point).
Switch receiving flask when vapor temperature rises towards 100.0°C.
safety: Ethanol is highly flammable. Keep all open flames away from distillation apparatus. Ensure system is open to atmosphere.
